why: JavaScript units through the checker's JavaScript mode (allowJs, checkJs). index.js: the module-level constant is the module unit's (WITNESS: a binding the module holds differs); scale, untyped, is refused by the lint by name (untyped-js) and lane B's WITNESS stays in its row; double is typed by JSDoc and read by both lanes. doc.js changes its JSDoc only: the types unit is PASS-typed, and inc, whose text is unchanged, has no row. No edit of a JavaScript file is left unassigned (--break js restores that route).
